planning_principle: Do not rerun 50 blindly. Preserve the 20 effectively covered objectives, close 13 partial objectives with the smallest semantically valid supplement, execute 8 not-demonstrated objectives, and add the required unseen holdouts. A holdout may also close a not-demonstrated objective only when the objective and failure mode are genuinely the same; otherwise evidence remains separate.

waves.purpose: Build fixtures, validators and evidence contracts only. Results from this wave are engineering evidence, not final certification evidence.
Run deterministic negative, boundary, currentness and schema/transport cases against the final stable candidate.
Run model-dependent UI/materialization/depth/high-complexity holdouts and bind final performance budgets.
Run repeated stochastic stability, differential/metamorphic/mutation gates and independent semantic review before freeze/Gate G.

cases.expected: Correct route/provenance decision without memorized branch/path assumptions; unknown ownership remains fail-closed.
cases.learning: Proves routing/provenance generalization beyond HP001.

cases.expected: Stale bound revision is rejected until fresh reread and explicit rebind produce current authority.
cases.learning: Separates fresh-read success from actual stale-to-current transition behavior.

cases.expected: Caller-declared currentness is ignored/rejected; provider/server-derived exact currentness remains authority.
cases.learning: Proves source-first trust does not depend on worker claims.

cases.expected: Execution blocks without synthesizing authority, schema, Card or fallback source.
cases.learning: Materializes the fail-closed branch that the positive HP001 run only declares contractually.

cases.expected: Exactly the applicable Card is selected, provenance-bound and consumed without broadening its authority.
cases.learning: Balances NO_CARD_GOVERNED with the positive Card path.

cases.expected: Cross-run/candidate-derived material cannot become authority and blocks if required canonical authority is absent.
cases.learning: Turns a forbidden-mode declaration into executable negative evidence.

cases.expected: Unknown Card shape or Card/authority conflict cannot be autocanonicalized; fail closed or return governed no-card outcome as contract dictates.
cases.learning: Proves Card generalization and conflict handling beyond known fixtures.

cases.expected: Existing correct typed-context case is rerun on the final candidate and its context-build/runtime timing is bound without changing semantics.
cases.learning: Closes only the missing performance dimension; it does not count as a new independent semantic case.

cases.expected: Typed-context compiler rejects omission of a material required field before model/runtime execution.
cases.learning: Proves schema completeness at the executable context boundary.

cases.expected: Incompatible type/version fails closed; no implicit coercion or schema invention.
cases.learning: Separates typed validity from mere field presence.

cases.expected: Prohibited metadata cannot enter executable typed context even if structurally well-formed.
cases.learning: Moves metadata security from downstream Composer only to typed-context ingress.

cases.expected: Minimum-sufficient context resolves the required adapter exactly, records provenance and avoids overfetch/invention.
cases.learning: Generalizes beyond HP001 where required_adapter_count=0.

cases.expected: Canonical schema/Composer boundary rejects malformed envelope deterministically.
cases.learning: Creates direct evidence for malformed transport rather than inferring it from validator existence.

cases.expected: Incompatible schema version is rejected before Composer/materialization; no silent downgrade or coercion.
cases.learning: Proves version compatibility is explicit rather than incidental.

cases.expected: A declared compatible representation preserves canonical semantics and boundary validation.
cases.learning: Proves compatible evolution without weakening fail-closed version checks.

cases.expected: Existing valid materialization is rerun on the final candidate and UI materialization latency/cost is bound.
cases.learning: Closes the missing performance dimension without inventing a second semantic objective.

cases.expected: Material validator catches a semantically contradictory layout even when required strings/fields are present.
cases.learning: Prevents nominal completeness from passing contradictory UI structure.

cases.expected: A materially different UI composition satisfies the same semantic contract without copying HP001 layout.
cases.learning: Proves UI generalization instead of memorized marketplace composition.

cases.expected: Existing valid Composer payload path is timed on the final candidate and bound to the final budget.
cases.learning: Adds performance evidence only; does not duplicate Composer correctness evidence.

cases.expected: Injection/internal-field contamination cannot bypass allowlist/mode constraints or leak into Composer output.
cases.learning: Extends metadata-leak coverage to an active adversarial injection path.

cases.expected: A new but explicitly allowed structure passes without implicit allowlist expansion; neighboring forbidden structure still fails.
cases.learning: Proves allowlist generalization and boundary sharpness.

cases.expected: Quality/depth gates reject an output that looks valid structurally but lacks material reasoning/coverage.
cases.learning: Distinguishes substantive depth from schema compliance.

cases.expected: Runtime makes an evidence-bound reasoned decision, surfaces unresolved authority when necessary and avoids arbitrary shallow completion.
cases.learning: Tests reasoning depth under ambiguity rather than completeness on a straightforward prompt.

cases.expected: Independent reviewer with no producer context judges the unseen output substantive, source-bound and sufficiently deep.
cases.learning: Closes the explicit frozen-bundle gap independent_semantic_review_performed=false.

cases.expected: Final integrated candidate records end-to-end/profile/prompt/runtime latency and passes explicit budgets without quality regression.
cases.learning: Replaces frozen pre-integration timing with certification timing on the actual final candidate.

cases.expected: High-complexity input stays functionally/semantically correct and within declared resource ceilings, or fails closed before unsafe degradation.
cases.learning: Establishes a real upper-bound behavior instead of extrapolating from one HP001 workload.

cases.expected: Repeated executions preserve semantic decisions/quality while quantifying latency/token/consistency variation; correlated repeats are analyzed hierarchically, not counted as independent cases.
cases.learning: Introduces the only place where clustered/mixed-effects statistical interpretation may be justified.

cases.expected: Deterministic replay on final candidate reproduces validators/materialization and records replay cost without being misclassified as independent review.
cases.learning: Closes replay performance while preserving the conceptual boundary between replay and independent review.

cases.expected: Controlled compatible version/currentness transition preserves intended semantics and provenance; incompatible transition fails closed.
cases.learning: Tests replay robustness beyond byte-identical exact-head reproduction.

cases.expected: Brand-new real case traverses full governed pipeline, passes deterministic/material/quality/performance gates and then independent semantic review.
cases.learning: Provides the final generalization proof that cannot be obtained by replaying HP001.

holdout_contract.rule: Exactly one designated unseen holdout per family is the minimum. Additional new cases may exist but do not replace distinct-objective coverage.

execution_economy.macrolot_policy: Bundle safe cases by execution wave, but retain objective-level receipts and do not count shared execution as independent evidence when objective/failure-mode is duplicated.

final_gate: All 50 objectives effectively COVERED; 10/10 family holdouts PASS; mutation/metamorphic/differential/transversal gates PASS; performance budgets PASS; independent semantic review PASS; then freeze. Gate G/Golden remain separate authorization boundaries.
